name: zrndr_span_occlusion_build_span_list
description: zRndr_SpanOcclusion::BuildSpanList walks one occlusion column, depth-tests the pending span against copied column spans, splits or trims visible fragments, appends visible outputs, and advances the span pool cursor.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because x87 depth comparisons/interpolation and ESP-relative depth scratch slots still render as long-double/fconvert temporaries and stack-arg aliases.
VC5SP3 compile-only verification is recorded for the production source body; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent zRndr span-occlusion pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x491840 validates the fastcall spanList and column-index arguments, stack spanCount parameter, span-column table lookup, empty/trailing-visible insertion, depth-order call to zRndr_SpanOcclusion::TestSpanDepthOrderPair, visible fragment splitting/trimming, output span coalescing, and g_spanAllocCursor advancement.

The native build-span-list smoke verifies empty-column emission, full occlusion without cursor advancement, visible left-fragment output before an occluder, spanCount writes, visible span array contents, and pool cursor behavior.
